reports.days.last_24h.explanation: Reports page, Custom range: the option in the 'number of days' dropdown that shows the rolling last 24 hours up to now (not the business day, which is the Today chip). Sits in a narrow select.

reports.eod.day_x.as_of.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: label before the time the figures were read.

reports.eod.day_x.empty.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line shown when nothing was sold since the last day close.

reports.eod.day_x.failed.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the figures could not be loaded. Names the Show day so far button, so keep that name identical to its translation.

reports.eod.day_x.hide.explanation: Reports, End of day tab: button that hides the loaded day-so-far figures.

reports.eod.day_x.intro.explanation: Reports, End of day tab: one paragraph under the heading saying the day-so-far report uses the end-of-day layout but closes, stores and resets nothing.

reports.eod.day_x.invalid_request.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the request could not be read (malformed or oversized form).

reports.eod.day_x.paper.title.explanation: Printed day-so-far report on the receipt printer: title line at the top, above the end-of-day layout. A read of the day so far, never an end-of-day (Z) report. Printed in capitals where the language has them; plain ASCII hyphen so it prints on every charset.

reports.eod.day_x.paper_label.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: accessible name of the preview block that shows the printed report as text.

reports.eod.day_x.print.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: button that prints the report (figures as of the moment it is pressed) on the receipt printer. Not an end-of-day (Z) report.

reports.eod.day_x.print_failed.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the receipt printer is off, not set up or did not answer. Names the Receipt printer settings section and the Print day so far button, so keep those names identical to their translations.

reports.eod.day_x.print_ok.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: confirmation beside the Print button once the receipt printer accepted the report.

reports.eod.day_x.printing.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: short status beside the Print button while the print request runs (up to 15 seconds).

reports.eod.day_x.show.explanation: Reports, End of day tab: button that loads the day-so-far figures. Pressing it again reads fresh figures.

reports.eod.day_x.since.explanation:
Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line naming the last day close the figures start from.

Placeholders:
- %s: date and time of the last day close

reports.eod.day_x.since_first.explanation: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line shown instead of the date when this till has never closed a day.

reports.eod.day_x.title.explanation: Reports, End of day tab: heading of the day-so-far section. A read of everything since the last day close, NOT an end-of-day (Z) report.

reports.eod.fiscal_device.mismatch.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

reports.eod.fiscal_device.mismatch_count.explanation:
Reports > End of day archive, Turkish fiscal device (ÖKC) check: shown when the device's receipt count differs from the till's tender count on it.

Placeholders:
- %s: the device's receipt count (a number)
- %s: the till's tender count on the device (a number)

reports.eod.no_sale_opens.explanation: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: column header, the number of drawer opens per cashier. Also used on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_title.explanation: Reports, End of day, archived report detail: heading of the table of cash-drawer opens without a sale. Also used as the row label (with the count) on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_total.explanation: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: label of the total row.

reports.eod.x_report_link.explanation: Reports, End of day tab: a link under the heading to the X report on the Shifts page.

reports.online_channels.cancelled_unpaid.explanation: Note under the Online channels table: how many orders in the period were cancelled before the customer paid and are therefore left out of all figures ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

reports.online_channels.col.currency.explanation: Column heading: the ISO currency code of the orders in that row (amounts are never added across currencies).

reports.online_channels.col.gross.explanation: Column heading: sum of the order totals as the channel reported them (including shipping and any tax the channel added). Not 'gross of tax' in the accounting sense; avoid a word that means 'including VAT'.

reports.online_channels.col.net.explanation: Column heading: order totals minus refunds. Means 'after refunds', not 'excluding tax'.

reports.online_channels.col.orders.explanation: Column heading: number of online orders counted in that row.

reports.online_channels.col.refunds.explanation: Column heading: amount refunded so far on those orders by the channel.

reports.online_channels.currency_total.explanation: Row label: total of all channels for one currency (shown only when two or more channels use that currency).

reports.online_channels.empty.explanation: Online channels report when no online order is left to count in the selected period.

reports.online_channels.link.explanation: Link from the Online channels report to the Online orders list page.

reports.online_channels.notice.explanation: Line under the Online channels heading: these orders are not till sales and are not in the till's key figures, the cash drawer, the day-end (Z) report or the fiscal journal. Describe, do not claim compliance.

reports.online_channels.refunds_note.explanation: Note under the Online channels table: refunds are counted in the period the order was placed, not the day the refund happened.

reports.online_channels.title.explanation: Heading of the Online channels report: totals of web-shop and marketplace orders for the selected period.

reports.tab.online_channels.explanation: Reports tab button: totals of orders from the shop's web shop and marketplaces (sales channels), not till sales. Different from the 'Payments & channels' tab, which is about payment methods at the till.

reports.today.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

reports.zpaper.articles_more.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the top items when the list is cut short; the full list is on the screen.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many more items are not printed (a number)

reports.zpaper.by_article.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_article_group.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item category. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_department.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per department (top-level category). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_operator.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per cashier. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_order_type.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales split into eat-in and takeaway. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_till.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per till (register). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cash.calculated.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the cash the drawer should hold. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.cash_sales.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken for sales. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.new_float.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash left in the drawer for the next shift. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.opening_float.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash in the drawer when the shift opened. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_ins.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash put into the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_outs.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken out of the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.tips_held_out.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash tips kept apart from the shop's takings. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also the row label of the on-screen X report's cash breakdown on the Shifts page. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.title.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the cash drawer count against the expected cash. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cleared_baskets.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: shopping baskets the cashier cleared with New sale before taking payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before the baskets' total amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of cleared baskets

reports.zpaper.cleared_title.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting shopping baskets cleared with New sale before payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.end_of_day.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the period line of an older day-based report.

Placeholders:
- %s: the business day, as YYYY-MM-DD

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.match.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count matches the till's.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.mismatch.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count differs from the till's.

Placeholders:
- %d: the device's receipt count (a number)
- %d: the till's payment count on the device (a number)

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.no_activity.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device recorded nothing and the till sent nothing to it in this period.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.other.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: count of other fiscal device slips. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.serial.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's serial number (row label).

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.till_tender.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: how many payments the till sent to the fiscal device (ÖKC). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.title.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the Turkish fiscal device (ÖKC) check. Keep 'OKC'/'ÖKC' as it is. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_closed_mi.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the device's Z numbers when it closed its own day inside this period. At most 30 characters with the numbers left out, so the Z numbers still fit the 42-column paper.

Placeholders:
- %s: the device's Z report numbers, comma-separated

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_no.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's own Z report number(s) (row label). 'Z' stays as it is.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_title.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting cash-drawer opens with no sale (no money moved, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_total.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: row label before the total number of no-sale drawer opens. A longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.receipts_range.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the first and last receipt numbers in this period. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

Placeholders:
- %s: the first receipt number
- %s: the last receipt number

reports.zpaper.stornos_note.explanation: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: explanation in brackets after the fixed German heading STORNOS. At most 31 characters: the whole line must fit 42.

reports.zpaper.voided.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: completed sales cancelled afterwards. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of voided receipts

reports.zpaper.vouchers_adjusted.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift voucher balances corrected by a manager. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of corrections

reports.zpaper.vouchers_imported.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers brought in from another system (opening balances). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of vouchers

reports.zpaper.vouchers_issued.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers sold in this period, under the fixed heading GUTSCHEINE. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of vouchers

reports.zpaper.vouchers_redeemed.explanation:
Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers used to pay in this period. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of redemptions
